newsitem.title: UK: London Clubs to invest in Las Vegas casino.
newsitem.headline: London Clubs to invest in Las Vegas casino.

text.p: British casino operator London Clubs International Plc said on Thursday it would invest $50 million in cash in the planned redevelopment of the Aladdin Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
The site's total redevelopment costs will be $750 million over two years, commencing in the third quarter, London Clubs said in a statement.
Under the deal with Aladdin Gaming Corp, London Clubs would receive a 25 percent equity stake in the hospitality and gaming operations and the underlying real estate.

The key features of the redevelopment included a new 2,600 room Aladdin Hotel, a 125,000 square foot main casino, a small speciality hotel/casino and a themed entertainment shopping mall, which will be separately financed and operated.
London Clubs said it would have a seat on the joint venture company's board of directors.
